findings.summary: tools/anchor-check.py is a freshly written reimplementation, not the vendored v3 checker spec §3.1 requires importing ("本包只搬运"), and §6 explicitly forbids authoring/changing the verification algorithm ("若发现算法缺陷，停下在 review 说明，不顺手改"). Evidence: spec §1 cites the --json block verbatim at anchor-check.py:199-209, but this file is 193 lines total with that block at 128-138; spec §1 documents --corpus bus:<channel> as part of the real interface, while this file rejects bus mode with "bus mode not yet implemented" and exit 1. The package premise is that the soft gate's judgment source must itself be mechanical and already audited; substituting an unaudited rewrite defeats it.

current_verified_hit does not verify the anchor at all: validate_anchor only checks that the file exists under repo-root and has at least line_num lines. The evidence quote/claim is never read (process_corpus reads only ev["anchor"]), so any anchor pointing into a sufficiently long file counts as a verified hit. The verification rate that spec §2/§0.1 designate as the soft gate's judgment source is therefore mechanical but vacuous — it measures "file is long enough", not anchor verification.

sums_ok is a tautology and can never be false in production, so spec §2's mandated loud guard against silent discard is dead. Every evidence increments exactly one of current_parsed/old_format/unparseable/discarded (empty anchor ⇒ unparseable; current-format ⇒ either discarded or current_parsed), and sums_ok is computed as the sum of exactly those four buckets == total. Spec §1 states sums_ok=false signals silent discard ("discarded > 0 或三类计数之和对不上"), and the shipped selftest itself asserts sums_ok=true for a corpus containing a discarded anchor (tools/anchor-check-selftest.sh:126-142). V4/W3 only exercise computeAnchorCheckResult with hand-written sums_ok=false input, so the production branch is unreachable and untested.

tools/fixtures/ contains only a placeholder README stating "The selftest creates its own test data at runtime" — the real fixtures were not brought over. V8 explicitly forbids this: "⛔ 只搬主文件不搬 selftest 与 fixtures 不算完成". The delivered selftest generates all corpora inline, so the vendored regression corpus is absent.

V7's second half is unmet: a missing --repo-root does not loudly fail, it silently degrades to a genuine-looking 0%. validate_anchor returns "repo-root not set" per anchor, the run still exits 0 with sums_ok=true, so computeAnchorCheckResult yields current_verified_hit/total = 0 and the head renders `dr-anchor-rate 0` — exactly the real-0%-vs-unavailable conflation §2/V5 forbid. Spec §1 requires the checker to fail loudly and "绝不猜". The engine also never inspects loud_failures. No test drives spawnAcProcess throwing, so the required "一例失败传播" is absent.

V4 requires sums_ok===false to be treated as failure with the rate null AND visibly named ("核验率 null + 在报告与落盘件里点名 sums_ok=false"). The implementation only nulls the rate, so the head renders bare `unavailable`, indistinguishable from a crash, and nothing names sums_ok=false in the report. No test asserts the naming requirement.

V9 evidence is internally contradictory and therefore does not establish the required baseline comparison: the dev-note records a baseline of 22 files / 274 tests and claims "新增 1 file / 17 tests", yet reports 23 files / 428 tests. 274 + 17 = 291, not 428, so either the baseline was misrecorded or the reported totals are not from the claimed run.

The retained G4c U7 test is now zero-power and its name is false: it claims "production assembleGenerateDeps throws AnchorCheckNotWiredError" but injects generateDeps whose stub constructs the error itself and then asserts the very instance it created. Production deps no longer throw it, and AnchorCheckNotWiredError (src/tick-run.ts:341-349) is dead code with no production consumer.

The topic-slug derivation for the anchor-check.json drop path is duplicated inline instead of reusing slugify/deriveExportPath from src/export.ts:39-58. The two copies are currently identical, so V6's "导出件同目录" holds only by coincidence and can silently diverge from the actual export directory.

The dr-anchor-rate field now carries a unit-less fraction (0.5 / 0.95) while pre-existing tests still write percentages (100 / 95 / 0) into the same field, and the soft gate is specified as "<90%". Since renderReportHead stringifies the raw number with no unit marker, the gate's input is ambiguous across the repo's own writers.
